device.description: 8-bit 50-200 kSPS SAR ADC with SPI-compatible serial output
device.note: adc081s021.pdf (SNAS308G) p.3 pin configuration and functions, p.4 recommended operating conditions, p.6 output coding, p.7 timing requirements and Figure 2 serial timing, p.12 serial interface, p.13 transfer function, p.14 modes of operation

pages: p.3 (pins, DBV and NGF same numbering), p.4 (ROC: VA 2.7-5.25 V, digital inputs -0.3 to 5.25 V regardless of VA, SCLK 25 kHz-20 MHz), p.7 (tEN 20 ns, tACC 40 ns at 2.7-3.6 V, tDIS 25 ns; Figure 2: SCLK idles high, data out on falling edges, 3 leading zeros, 8 data bits, 4 trailing zeros, TRI-STATE after the 16th falling edge), p.12 (conversion at CS fall, frame), p.13 (straight binary), p.14 (normal / shutdown mode)
notModeled: analog input; the conversion is clocked by SCLK (the result is the 0 V code 0x00 at once)
SPI mode 3 (SCLK idles high, data out on falling edges, read on rising edges); with SCLK low at CS fall the receiver captures an extra leading zero (datasheet), which mode 3 does not show
SDATA goes TRI-STATE after the 16th falling SCLK edge (idle "z" after the 15 pattern bits) or at CS rise
shutdown mode: CS high between the 2nd and 10th SCLK falling edges powers down until the next CS fall (no visible digital effect: the next CS fall wakes it; the 1 us power-up time is not modeled)
CS high between the 10th and 16th falling edges aborts the conversion (SDATA to TRI-STATE)
tQUIET / tACQ and SCLK frequency limits; tACC is 20 ns at VA 4.75-5.25 V (the model uses 40 ns)
variants: ADC081S021 / ADC081S051 / ADC081S101 are the same pinout and frame at different sample-rate ranges (separate datasheets); ADC101S/ADC121S are the 10/12-bit parts
